title: Road Ambush
text: Two masked figures step from behind a burnt-out car, weapons raised. One drags a length of chain across the asphalt. "Supplies. Now."

outcome.text: You drive them back after a brutal struggle. They scatter into the ruins, leaving behind a few scraps.
You toss a bag onto the road. They take it and let you pass without another word.

choices.label: Back up and find a detour

outcome.text: You reverse quietly and take a side road. It costs time and fuel, but nobody gets hurt.

title: Derelict Gas Station
text: A crumbling station sits off the highway, windows long shattered. The pumps are dead — but the underground tanks might still hold something.

choices.label: Dig down to the reserve tanks

outcome.text: Using a makeshift tool, you crack open a buried tank. Crude fuel, but it'll burn.
You find a rusted jerry can with a few litres sloshing around at the bottom. Better than nothing.
You roll past without stopping. The station disappears in the rear-view mirror.

title: Roadside Stranger
text: A figure is slumped against a cracked mile marker, barely conscious. Their lips are cracked from thirst. They look up at you with hollow eyes and say nothing.

outcome.text: You patch them up. They grip your hand before you leave — grateful, speechless. The group feels the weight of that moment.
You press a small parcel into their hands. It won't save them. But it might buy them another day.

choices.label: You can't save everyone — keep going

outcome.text: You drive away. Nobody says anything for a long time. The silence is heavy.

title: Radiation Warning
text: The geiger counter screams. A bruised, glowing cloud mass rolls in from the east — fast. You have maybe three minutes before it's on top of you.

outcome.text: You wait it out in a basement, rationing food while the storm passes overhead. Hours later, the counter quiets.

choices.label: Rig a radiation shield from scrap

outcome.text: You bolt sheet metal to the roof and windows. It holds. The group is shaken but unharmed.
You blast through the edge of the storm at full speed. Everyone is nauseous and frightened. But you're through.

title: Wandering Trader
text: A cart appears on the horizon, pulled slowly by an old man in a heavy coat and cracked gas mask. He raises a hand — the wasteland gesture for "not hostile."

outcome.text: He eyes your food stores carefully, nods, and rolls two fuel drums off his cart. A fair trade by wasteland standards.
He sorts through your scrap pile, picks what he wants, and loads you up with dried provisions. Nobody goes hungry tonight.
He produces a battered medkit from under the cart. Expired labels, but the contents look intact.

choices.label: Wave him off and keep moving

outcome.text: You roll past with a nod. He watches you go without a word.

title: Collapsed Bridge
text: The bridge ahead has buckled — a section of road hangs over the river below, twisted rebar exposed. The fast route is gone.

outcome.text: Forty miles out of the way on cracked back roads. The tank dips badly, but you make it across.

choices.label: Reinforce it with scrap and cross

outcome.text: Two hours of work. The repair won't last — but it holds long enough for you to cross.
Every second feels like the last. The structure groans beneath you. It holds — barely. Nobody breathes until you reach the other side.

title: Feral Pack
text: A pack of mutated dogs circles the vehicle in the dark, growling low. Their eyes catch the headlights. They smell the food. They are not afraid of you.

outcome.text: It's loud and ugly. You drive them back, but not without cost. One of them got to the supply bag before you could stop it.

choices.label: Burn some food to make a fire

outcome.text: The flames send them scrambling into the dark, yapping. Old instincts die hard, even in mutants.

choices.label: Gun the engine and drive through them

outcome.text: You hit the accelerator and scatter them. A few thuds against the chassis. You don't look back.

title: Abandoned Clinic
text: A faded red cross hangs above a shattered doorway. Inside, overturned beds and scattered supplies. It smells sterile… and wrong.

outcome.text: You find a sealed cabinet. Some of it is still usable.

choices.label: Grab what you can and leave

outcome.text: You grab supplies quickly. Something crashes deeper inside. You don't stay to find out what.
You step back outside. Some places aren’t worth the risk.

title: Blocked Highway
text: Cars are piled across the highway ahead. A choke point. Too clean. Too quiet.

outcome.text: You move enough wreckage to squeeze through.
You avoid the choke point entirely.
Metal screams as you push through. Something breaks.

title: Static Signal
text: The radio crackles to life. A voice repeats coordinates before dissolving into static.

outcome.text: You find a hidden cache buried near the coordinates.
Probably a trap.

title: Engine Trouble
text: The engine coughs, sputters, and loses power. You coast to a stop.

outcome.text: You patch it together. It’ll hold.
It works… but barely.

title: Overgrown Farm
text: Fields stretch out, wild but still growing. Something edible might still be here.

outcome.text: You gather what you can.
You find tools and supplies.

title: Burning Wreck
text: A vehicle burns on the roadside, flames licking the sky. Something might still be salvageable.

outcome.text: You grab what you can before the heat forces you back.
You move on.

title: Sinkhole
text: The road ahead collapses into a deep pit.

outcome.text: You carefully navigate around it.
You make it… barely.

title: Ration Dispute
text: Tensions rise over dwindling food. Voices get louder.

outcome.text: You manage to settle things.
Food lasts longer, but morale suffers.

title: Hidden Cache
text: You uncover a hidden stash buried beneath rubble.

outcome.text: A lucky find.

title: Lonely Grave
text: A small grave marked with stones. Someone cared enough to bury them.

outcome.text: The group grows quiet. It matters.
You find something useful… but at a cost.

title: Sealed Fuel Cache
text: Half-buried under rubble, you uncover a sealed military-grade fuel container. Untouched. Intact. A miracle.

outcome.text: You siphon every drop. This could change everything.
You note it for later. If there is a later.

title: Hidden Bunker
text: A concealed hatch beneath debris leads to an underground bunker. The air inside is stale, but untouched.

outcome.text: Stockpiles. Food, tools, supplies. Someone planned for this.
You don’t trust places like this.

title: Abandoned Tool Kit
text: A rusted toolbox lies beside the road, half-buried in dust.

outcome.text: Still usable. Barely.
You keep moving.

title: Thick Fog
text: A heavy fog rolls in, swallowing the road ahead.

outcome.text: You crawl forward carefully.
You nearly hit something. The group is shaken.

title: Dead Battery
text: The engine won’t turn over. Battery’s dead.

outcome.text: You rig a working replacement.
It works… eventually.

title: Old Map
text: You find a faded road map with handwritten markings.

outcome.text: You find a small cache along the way.
Too risky.

title: Distant Gunfire
text: Gunshots echo in the distance. Close enough to matter.

outcome.text: You arrive too late. But there are supplies left behind.
You steer clear.

title: Quiet Night
text: For once, the night is still. No sounds. No movement.

outcome.text: Everyone sleeps easier.

title: Old Minefield
text: Warning signs half-buried in dirt. Mines. Still active… maybe.

outcome.text: Every second is tense. You make it through.
You take the long way.

title: Supply Drop
text: A crate lies smashed open — marked with an old relief agency symbol.

outcome.text: Canned food. Sealed. Still good.

title: Dust Storm
text: A wall of dust rolls across the wasteland, swallowing everything in its path.

outcome.text: You sit in silence as the storm howls past.
Visibility drops to nothing. You nearly lose control.

title: Broken Signpost
text: A bent highway sign points in two directions. One has been scratched out.

outcome.text: It’s longer, but safer.
You find something unexpected.

title: Freezing Night
text: The temperature drops fast after sunset.

outcome.text: The fire keeps everyone alive.
No one sleeps well.

title: Abandoned Convoy
text: Military trucks sit idle on the road. Doors open. No bodies.

outcome.text: You find useful gear.
You move on quickly.

title: Injured Animal
text: A wounded animal limps across the road.

outcome.text: Not pretty, but necessary.
It limps away. The group feels better.

title: Radio Tower
text: A tall communications tower still stands.

outcome.text: You spot a safer route ahead.
Valuable electronics.

title: Survivor Camp
text: You find a hidden camp of survivors. They welcome you cautiously.

outcome.text: You leave better than you arrived.

title: Raider Trap
text: It was a trap. You're surrounded.

outcome.text: You escape, barely.

title: Sealed Vault
text: A massive underground vault door stands slightly open.

outcome.text: Unbelievable. Supplies untouched for decades.

title: Strange Signal
text: A repeating signal cuts through all static. It doesn’t sound human.

outcome.text: You find something… you don’t understand.
Some things are better left alone.

title: Night Attack
text: Screams tear through the night. Shapes move just beyond the firelight. Something — or someone — is attacking.

outcome.text: You fight them off, but not without loss.
You escape, leaving chaos behind.

title: Sniper Fire
text: A shot cracks. Then another. Someone is picking you off from a distance.

outcome.text: You close the distance, but one of you doesn’t make it.
You escape the kill zone.

title: Infected Wound
text: One of your group is feverish. The wound is infected… and getting worse.

outcome.text: You stabilize them. For now.
They survive… barely.
They don’t make it.

title: River Crossing
text: The bridge is gone. A fast-moving river blocks your path.

outcome.text: The current takes one of you.
It holds together. Barely.

title: Internal Theft
text: Supplies are missing. Someone in your group is stealing.

outcome.text: It turns violent.
Trust erodes.

title: Collapsed Building
text: The structure groans… then collapses while you're inside.

outcome.text: You recover supplies… and a body.
You barely make it out.

title: Animal Mauling
text: A massive mutated beast charges from the brush.

outcome.text: You kill it… but lose someone.
You escape its jaws.

title: Radiation Sickness
text: Someone begins vomiting. Skin pale. Eyes unfocused.

outcome.text: They recover slowly.
They die alone.

title: Bridge Collapse
text: Halfway across, the bridge gives way beneath you.

outcome.text: You make it… but not all of you.

title: Deserter
text: One of your group vanishes overnight. Supplies missing.

outcome.text: You find them… and end it.
They're gone.

title: Fire in Camp
text: Flames spread fast through your camp.

outcome.text: You lose supplies, but everyone lives.
You save gear… but not everyone.

title: Rockslide
text: A sudden rockslide crashes down from above.

outcome.text: You survive… barely.
You outrun it.

title: Last Stand
text: You're surrounded. No escape. Someone volunteers to hold them off.

outcome.text: You drive away as gunfire fades behind you.
